LSO.note: Mentions only a 'broader digital transformation strategy' in passing, with no standing, text, period, plan or reporting stated.

facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports the Lesotho Communications Authority granted Starlink Lesotho (Pty) Ltd a 10-year network service licence to provide internet to individuals and businesses.
Connecting Africa reports Starlink launched in Lesotho and, per the Starlink website, customers can buy the standard kit at R7,400 with residential subscriptions at R950 a month.
